name: Three-shot day in the life
description: Three reference-to-video shots merged into one clip (edge order is the cut order), with @step1 naming the first shot where a later shot has to match it. Add a schedule only after the person agreed to one.

nodes.title: Morning
nodes.prompt: @Image1 pulls the curtains open in a small bright bedroom, stretches, phone propped on the dresser, morning light. 5 seconds, one shot.

nodes.title: Coffee
nodes.prompt: @Image1 in the same outfit as @step1, pouring coffee in a compact kitchen, steam, handheld phone framing. 5 seconds.

nodes.title: Out the door
nodes.prompt: @Image1 grabs keys and a tote bag by the front door, checks the mirror, waves at the camera and leaves. Same outfit as @step1. 5 seconds.
